history_summary: Record native species-reference correspondences for B8-1 and A1 in PAH Consortium 4.
history_details: The B8-1 and A1 species descriptors receive native Bacillus_A paramycoides and Bacillus_A paranthracis reference correspondences: respectively 9 genomes with fraction 1.0 and 210 genomes with fraction 0.99. Reference populations do not identify experimental stock assemblies, and rounded fractions do not establish exact majority numerators. Preserve the three-stock B8-1/A1/A3 Consortium 4 and its existing unselected A3 mapping, 16S marker uncertainty, seven-day HPLC removal endpoints, and separate planktonic and static-biofilm assays. Do not introduce bentonite or six-day conditions from a different regime. Bacillus_A is a lineage label difference, not formal stock renaming. Existing source/assay/optimization/marker findings 2317-2319 remain distinct. Only two selected GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events changed. The pinned table has no verified upstream release label. All prior history remains unchanged; this bounded technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
